# R3BOOT | Integrated Recovery Center

> Dadar's integrated recovery and performance clinic. Clinical physiotherapy,
> contrast therapy (infrared sauna + ice bath), sports massage, clinical Pilates,
> cupping therapy, and hydrotherapy in Dadar East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400014.

## Core Services

- `Contrast Therapy -> https://www.r3boot.in/contrast-therapy-mumbai`: Clinically structured infrared sauna and ice bath protocol supervised by physiotherapists. 3:1 hot-to-cold ratio. Dadar, Mumbai.
- `Ice Bath Mumbai -> https://www.r3boot.in/ice-bath-mumbai`: Supervised cold immersion for muscle recovery. Physiotherapy-guided protocol.
- `Physiotherapy Dadar -> https://www.r3boot.in/physiotherapy-dadar`: Clinical physiotherapy by Dr. Hiral Parikh (15+ years) and Dr. Vaishali Rauniyar. Back pain, knee pain, sports injuries, post-surgery rehab.
- `Sports Massage Mumbai -> https://www.r3boot.in/sports-massage-mumbai`: Performance-driven sports massage for athletes by certified therapists.
- `Cupping Therapy Mumbai -> https://www.r3boot.in/cupping-therapy-mumbai`: Certified cupping therapy for muscle recovery and pain relief.
- `Clinical Pilates Mumbai -> https://www.r3boot.in/clinical-pilates-mumbai`: Physiotherapy-led Pilates for rehabilitation and core strengthening.

## Practitioners

- Dr. Hiral Parikh, Lead Physiotherapist, BPT D.Y. Patil College, 15+ years clinical experience, sports and post-surgical rehabilitation specialist.
- Dr. Vaishali Vijay Rauniyar, Physiotherapist, certified in Dry Needling and Aquatic Rehabilitation, sports and orthopedic rehab.
- Parinaaz Irani, Sport and performance psychologist, athlete mental health and mindset training.
- Akshay Anil Nalawde, Sports massage therapist, certified cupping therapy, 1,000+ athletes treated.
- Diyan Kubadia, Co-founder, professional cricketer, performance recovery specialist.
